nodes.label: Error: Invalid column 'borrado' on Custodios
nodes.rationale: Schema mismatch: EF Core model expected 'borrado' column on Custodios table, but the database column did not exist. This indicates a migration was not applied or model/schema was out of sync.

nodes.label: Error: InvalidCastException on Kits CANTIDAD column
nodes.rationale: EF Core expected CANTIDAD as Int32 but the database stored it as a string. This indicates a data type mismatch between the C# entity and the SQL column definition.
